update.title: The Ultimate Simulator Station Update
features: Ultimate Weather Engine: Inject live METARs, custom scenarios, or intense microbursts.
Complete Ground Handling & GSX: Control boarding, pushback, and all ground vehicles seamlessly.
Advanced Failure Management: Over 130 realistic system failures, now available for MSFS 2020/2024.
Interactive TCAS & AI Traffic: Inject traffic, practice wake turbulence, and handle runway incursions.
Advanced Flight Analysis: Review telemetry graphs, touchdown points, and get deep landing evaluations.
Instant World Tour Mode: Teleport to over 30 iconic global landmarks with a single tap.

announcement.title: Massive Leap Forward!
announcement.body:
Welcome to the biggest, most feature-packed update in our history! We have completely leveled up your flight simulation experience across MSFS (2020/2024) and X-Plane. Enjoy absolute command over the skies with our Ultimate Weather Engine, seamless GSX ground handling, deep flight analysis, and interactive TCAS traffic injection.

IMPORTANT: Update your Simulator Station Bridge to ensure flawless syncing for the new failure management and aircraft controls.

promo_banner.title: Ground Handling Perfected
promo_banner.body: Turnarounds just got incredibly immersive! Manage your entire ground crew, request boarding bridges, and call in all vehicles directly from your device.
